versions.changelog:
- Metadata file updated; no changes to functionality or user-facing documentation.
- Version incremented to 1.0.1.

- Initial release of academic-research skill.
- Search 250M+ academic papers using the OpenAlex API without an API key.
- Supports paper search by topic, author, or DOI; citation chain exploration; and deep reading for abstracts and full texts (when available).
- Provides structured metadata including title, authors, abstract, citation count, DOI, open access URL, and source.
- Features an automated literature review workflow with thematic clustering and synthesis.
- Outputs results in markdown or JSON for programmatic use.
